notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for callback enable and disable around a standard timestamped regional interaction. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, endpoint, logical-time implementation, and callback configuration. It verifies suppression and release of the region-qualified interaction and matching time-advance grant, exact parameter/tag/time/order/transport/retraction/region metadata, callback ordering at the grant boundary, and federation cleanup without provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador callback enable/disable and callback-servicing controls with publishInteractionClass/createRegion/subscribeInteractionClassWithRegions/sendInteractionWithRegions(time)/timeAdvanceRequest and FederateAmbassador receiveInteraction(time)/timeAdvanceGrant delivery
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador callback-control and timestamped regional interaction declarations
